notes:
## New features
- Points over a roof get an Above roof (m) field under Height (m AGL). Edit either and the other follows; the field appears only while the receptor or point source sits inside a building footprint, and updates when you drop it on or off a roof. A note warns when the point is below the roof (inside the building).
- Batch editing: with several receptors selected you can set the sound field, display symbol, floor stack and building assignment for all of them. Buildings, barriers, berms, roads and railways keep their full property panels when several of the same kind are selected, and each change applies to every selected object (geometry stays per object). Building plan-display toggles and line-source display styles also apply to the whole selection.
- Plan contours run over roofs at or below the contour height: a 7 m building under a 7.5 m contour is calculated and coloured instead of left as a hole. Objects at or below the contour height draw under the contour layer, so opacity and blend modes show them through it; taller objects, sources and receptors stay on top.

## Changes
- Contour calculations are much faster on sites with many buildings and reflections, with identical levels: the P1984b plan sheet takes about 19 s instead of 8½ minutes, and a section about 16 s.
- A section or plan calculated as Calculated Grid and then shown as Interpolated Raster or SmartSmooth is refined first, exactly as a smoothed Calculate is, so plan and section views use the same processing and can be compared directly.
- Point source Height is always the height above local ground. Roof-mounted plant shows its offset in the Above roof field instead of relabelling the height.

## Bug fixes
- Sections no longer show stair-stepped or scalloped contours when shown with an interpolating method. Building shadow lines in sections are now exact straight edges even when the source is slightly off the section line, so contours stay crisp where a roof corner cuts off the direct sound.
- Interpolated Raster no longer drops whole bands where the calculation area narrows at a roof corner or barrier end, which left grey gaps instead of contours reaching the obstacle.
- The 3D view draws receptors and point sources at their true height above ground; a receptor over a roof was drawn on top of the roof while sections and calculations used ground height.
- Receptor floor stacks in 3D no longer show a stray short line beneath upper markers.
- While the 3D camera moves, grainy contact shading is switched off and ambient occlusion keeps its at-rest quality, to stop the "static" shimmer during navigation.
- Menu bar menus show full item names, right-align shortcuts and highlight the whole row.
- Calculations with an area source near buildings, barriers or roads no longer stop with "Numerically unresolved area-source projection cut".
